title: An import's or an export's result
description: B13: the one JSON document the game runtime's image prints, as its last line on standard output, when vhd runs it to import or export a world's save in a one-off container (Game runtimes, Restore, import and export share one path). vhd validates it against this contract; output that breaks it, or no output, counts as refused, though an import cut short after it named its backup may have kept it, which the world's backups then list. done: an import's save is a backup of the world, or an export's save is in the install folder. refused: nothing was kept, and reason says why.

action.description: import: a save in the install folder became a backup of the world. export: a backup of the world was copied into the install folder in the layout the game reads.

reason.description: Why it was refused, in one line of printable text, which vhd shows to the server manager.

backup.description: The backup it made (import) or copied (export).

save.description: The save that backup holds, so the server manager sees which save was taken.

written.description: When the game completed the save, in UTC.
